title: dbz context overlay
description: A presentation-layer profile that tailors query output to an industry, jurisdiction, or client-template context. Overlays NEVER alter mappings, tiers, or tables - they filter and reorder presentation, and every suppression is disclosed via suppressed_count. Precedence when combined: jurisdiction (regulatory) > industry > client-template; ties break on precedence_rank then id. Shipped client templates are placeholders only - no real client names or data, ever.

match.description: Free-form hints about when this overlay applies (informational).

default_min_tier.description: Applied to master queries only when the user did not pass --min-tier.

default_scope_fedramp.description: Applied to scope queries only when the user did not pass a level.

emphasized_frameworks.description: Framework names (must canonicalize via framework_labels) shown first in framework-keyed results.

framework_universe.description: When present, framework-keyed rows outside this set (plus NIST 800-53, the spine) are suppressed - and counted in suppressed_count, never silently dropped.
